title: ABCL635 Phase 2 clinical update dated August 10, 2026
publisher: AbCellera Biologics Inc. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: No SAEs or severe (Grade 3+) AEs in ABCL635 group; completion of 12-week follow up, dose selection, and regulatory interactions remain next steps.
summary: The SEC-filed clinical presentation supplies the randomized population, endpoint magnitudes, adverse-event detail, four-week data cutoff, cross-study limitations, and remaining late-stage development steps.
